expectations.text: Recommends extracting the shared Avatar component (NOT keeping 12 inline copies)
expectations.evidence: 'Extract the shared <Avatar/>.' Recommendation: 'Extract <Avatar/> into a shared component... and replace all 12 inline copies.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the pure-presentation / understood-in-isolation test (low external context to consume)
expectations.evidence: 'Avatar is a pure presentational component — props in, markup out, no data fetching... Pure leaf components are the safest possible thing to share, because there's no hidden context to lose when you pull them out.' Also 'It's a leaf, not a dependency you have to chase... self-contained ~50-line file.'

expectations.text: Rejects the 'keep inline for self-containment' argument as misapplied to a reusable primitive
expectations.evidence: 'locality of behaviour is genuinely valuable... but Avatar is the wrong place to apply it.' 'true for genuinely local logic... But Avatar fails the test.' 'The senior is pricing in a cost that barely exists.'

expectations.text: Frames the shared component as a real abstraction (read at call site without opening internals), not just DRY
expectations.evidence: 'A clear name and a tight prop interface mean an agent grasps the full contract from the import line without even opening the file.'
